استمدوا (form X)
# اِسْتَمَدُّوا (istamaddū) /is.ta.mad.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَمَدَّ (istamadda)
# اُسْتُمِدُّوا (ustumiddū) /us.tu.mid.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَمَدَّ (istamadda)
# اِسْتَمِدُّوا (istamiddū) /is.ta.mid.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَمَدَّ (istamadda)
